roofline.description: Attainable performance per node using the roofline model
roofline.regime: compute-bound if peak_gflops_per_node <= hbm_bandwidth_gbs * arithmetic_intensity_flop_per_byte, else memory-bound

effective_nodes.description: Actual number of nodes used, capped by system capacity

single_node_compute.description: Time to compute the workload on a single node

parallel_scaling.description: Parallel execution time using Amdahl's law

communication.description: Communication overhead using the alpha-beta model with logarithmic spanning tree
communication.note: log2 is the base-2 logarithm; use math.log2 in Python

io_time.description: I/O time using aggregate system bandwidth

total_time.description: Total predicted execution time per application per system

ssi.description: Workflow System Sustained Investment metric relative to reference system
ssi.note: SSI for the reference system equals sum of all weights (should be 1.0)

cost.description: Total system procurement cost based on peak node allocation
cost.allocated_nodes: max(effective_nodes across all applications for this system)

cost_efficiency.description: SSI normalized by relative cost compared to reference system

timing.dominant_bottleneck: string: compute, communication, or io (whichever of t_parallel, t_comm, t_io is largest)
